title: instant money and sell
features:
- What does the script do?:
1. Fills your inventory with poop
2. Sells everything almost immediately
3. Server hops so detectors can't kick you

- I recommend doing the following:
Eat as much of your stock as you can and then run the script

The code is free to use and requires no credit.
script:
local module = loadstring(game:HttpGet"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LeoKholYt/roblox/main/lk_serverhop.lua")() -- serverhop script. is not mine!! (im lazy lol)

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packets.Packet.RemoteEvent:FireServer(buffer.create(7999)) -- generates all the poop, i think 7999 is the max. 4 is the min (only generates one with 4)

task.wait(.75) -- wait long enough so as not to be kicked

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packets.Packet.RemoteEvent:FireServer(buffer.fromstring("\3\0")) -- sell all the poop


module:Teleport(game.PlaceId) -- serverhops
